title: Worth it if you're especially squeamish
text:
Worth it if you're especially squeamish. For $18 at the time of this writing, this product comes with two non-reusable sheets. That's quite expensive for what this thing does.

The design of this toilet unclogger is one that relies on an airtight seal with the toilet seat and the air pressure that can be created from that seal. A couple of issues arise: If your toilet seat covers too much of the rim of the toilet, this sheet will not be able to create the seal it needs without removing the seat. Even with a good seal, the pressure that can be generated may not be enough to move the clog.

What is good about this product is that when it works, it allows one to unclog the toilet without all the mess that might come along with it. If you're especially squeamish, then this product might actually be justifiable. Otherwise, the traditional plunger is still the better choice.
